entryConvention.primaryResearchBarrier: +2 ATR before -1 ATR within 20 post-entry symbol sessions

dataLimitations.survivorship: Reviewed 2026 universe is not point-in-time historical membership.
dataLimitations.cdrBenchmark: CAD CDR returns include FX effects while ^IXIC is USD; no FX/hedge series exists in the locked archive, so CDRs are excluded from headline comparison.
dataLimitations.independentPriceVerification: Pinned-source consistency is not independent market-price verification.

confirmedCalendar.distinction: Only confirmed intersection dates can create selections or zero-pick absences. Partial/missing-coverage dates are recorded separately and never reset an episode.

currentEarlyWatchAbsolutePath.note: Absolute CAD path diagnostic for current Early Watch CDR picks only. Benchmark excess is intentionally omitted because the locked archive lacks a CAD-compatible FX/hedged benchmark treatment.

cdrAssessment.challengerCdrResult: not computed because the challenger itself requires benchmark-relative strength and the locked archive does not provide a defensible CAD-compatible/FX-aware comparator

pairedEffectTargetMinusBaseline.bootstrapCalendar: 20-session circular blocks sampled on the full confirmed calendar; only sampled shared episode dates contribute to paired effects

legacyCloseToClose.label: Legacy scan-close-to-close Early Watch episode statistics; timing differs from challenger and is not mixed with next-session-entry outcomes.

randomEvidenceStorage.note: All generated random-control episode identities/outcome labels used for seed summaries are retained in chunked evidence; no seeds or observations are dropped.

randomDailyMatchingStorage.note: One record per challenger opportunity date × seed × control. Preserves target count, selected count and identities so daily matching can be independently audited.

controlledSelectionAudit.note: Deterministic Early Watch and trend+RS baseline counts/identities on every challenger opportunity date.
